summary: The change passes the caller abort signal into every device-login hub request, combines it with the request timeout, rechecks cancellation after reading each response and immediately before the credential write, and adds a focused table test covering approved polls, in-flight requests, and a completed exchange. No introduced defect was found.

evidence: scripts/api_cli.ts:1615-1656 hubPost takes an optional AbortSignal, combines it with AbortSignal.timeout, rethrows login_cancelled when the caller signal is aborted, and rechecks after reading the response body.
scripts/api_cli.ts:1674-1725 passes options.signal to the device authorization start and device token poll requests so Ctrl-C aborts an in-flight request.

scripts/api_cli.ts:1762-1767 and 1834-1868 pass the signal to the token exchange and check signal.aborted immediately before credentialStore.write, preventing persistence after a cancelled poll or exchange.

tests/api-cli.test.ts:2384-2478 adds focused cases for an approved poll, in-flight start, poll, and exchange requests, and a completed exchange, asserting exit 130 with login_cancelled and no credential file written.
